name: What factors should I consider when choosing new double hung windows?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing new double hung windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting new double hung windows, consider frame material (vinyl for low maintenance, wood for traditional look, fiberglass for durability), glass type (double-pane for insulation, Low-E coating for UV protection, argon gas for efficiency), and energy efficiency ratings (U-factor, SHGC). Also, think about style, color, hardware, and any specific features like tilt-in sashes for cleaning. Choose windows that complement your home's architecture and meet your budget and performance expectations, ensuring long-term comfort and savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider frame material, glass type, energy efficiency ratings, style, color, hardware, and cleaning features when choosing new double hung windows.
